answer: A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The karst counter is kept in quill and summit exposes each reset. Someone thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1988 identities would post 914 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
